releases.name: v1.4.5
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* Add opt-in report-only code-health collection by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/336
* fix(code-health): select compatible Swift coverage toolchain by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/337
* fix(code-health): collect CLI coverage and manual CI data by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/338
* fix(code-health): compare current CI and resolve CLI coverage fixture by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/339
* ci+style: rustfmt the workspace and gate cargo fmt --check (#352) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/385
* build: pin Rust 1.99.0 / Node 22, declare MSRV 1.88 with a CI gate (#353) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/386
* ci: least-privilege permissions, job timeouts, SHA-pinned actions and tools (#354) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/387
* ci: run engine-protocol, ORT host and release-guard suites on PRs; full Windows Node suite (#357) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/389
* docs: architecture map, change recipes and ADRs (#382) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/390
* fix: recover poisoned locks instead of panicking every later command (#359) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/391
* build: npm run verify, grouped node tests and CI parity (#350) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/392
* build: one reqwest stack; cargo-deny and npm audit gates (#355) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/393
* ci: clippy policy lints with a non-increasing baseline; remove dead code (#356) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/394
* fix(settings): preserve an invalid settings file before any replacement (#340) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/388
* test: delad testsupport-crate och testerna ut ur gud-filerna (#363, del 1) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/403
* engine host: övervakning som återhämtar sig utan omstart av appen (#366) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/404
* settings: schema_version, versionerade migreringar och per-fält-reparation utan tyst dataförlust (#365) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/402
* test: Vitest med typad IPC-mock, transpile-laddade tester flyttade, Prettier (#361, del A1) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/396
* engine host: maskinkontrollerat protokollkontrakt mellan Rust och Swift (#367) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/395
* test: komponenttester i happy-dom, Settings-pilot, ESLint och licensgrind för dev-beroenden (#361, del A2) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/405
* test: store.rs-testerna till syskonfil, fake_settings() och färre temp_dir-platser (#363, del 2) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/424
* build: rustls 0.23.46 för fyra nya säkerhetsråd (RUSTSEC-2026-0346…0349) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/431
* test(download): poll i stället för fast väntan i avbrottstestet; logga misslyckad borttagning av temp-fil by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/429
* cli: utdata- och exitlager, ingen panik vid stängd stdout, felobjekt för --json (#364) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/425
* core: blockerande filarbete av async-executorn, fsync före rename, delad HTTP-klient (#368) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/427
* settings: skilj en sparad ändring från en misslyckad återläsning (#341) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/428
* test(qa): webbläsartesterna skriver till OS:ets temp-katalog, så att de går även på Linux by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/432
* kontrakt: delade transportfixtures, eventkatalog och genererad CommandMap mellan Rust och TS (#347) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/426
* frontend: delade runes-stores, typade eventprenumerationer utan läckor, färre IPC-anrop (#362) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/430
* möten: säker publicering och omförsök för reprocessing-cache och förslag, delad publish_new (#342) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/433
* fel: typade kommandofel, sökvägsskrubbning och felkoder i frontend, del 1 (#360) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/434
* ci: en setup-action, en lista över cargo-grindar, strukturella CI-tester (#358) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/435
* build(deps): zip 9 i sagascript-core för RUSTSEC-2026-0367, -0368 och -0369 by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/450
* cli: en delad resolver för profil, språk och engångsordlista (#346) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/449
* core: models/ utan beroende på settings och bruten settings↔transcription-cykel, del 1 (#372) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/448
* fix(code-health): align CI inventory and preserve safe crash diagnostics by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/455
* fix(code-health): retain safe Rust runtime crash categories by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/456
* fix(code-health): scope selected Xcode to Swift coverage by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/457
* cli: transcribe delad i moduler, frysta kontraktstester och en typad kodare-policy, del 1 (#343) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/454
* test(code-health): isolate Swift selector environment expectations by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/459
* app: commands.rs delad per domän, persist_and_sync som enda skrivväg, macos_mic till platform (#370) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/453
* test(engine-host): mät avbrottet mot laddningen, inte mot schemaläggningen by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/462
* core: whisper_backend delad i moduler, karakteriseringstester och unsafe impl utredd, del 1 (#371) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/460
* app: main.rs delad i tray, updater, launch, settings_watcher och dictation (#369) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/461
* cli: transcribe får en injicerad inferens-seam och enum Source, del 2 (#343) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/464
* settings: en implementation per inställningsoperation för CLI och app, paritetstest och tabellstyrt nyckelregister, del 1 (#373) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/467
* core: meeting/ och diarization/ som delsystem, låst lista över toppnivåmoduler, del 2a (#372) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/468
* ci: modellcachen hashar models/sources.rs efter flytten i #372 by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/469
* app: setters som ersätter hela kopian behåller registrerade kortkommandon och nedgraderingen (#458) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/470
* fix(code-health): emit schema-safe CI tool identity by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/463
* security: bump advisory-flagged deps and tighten CSP (#445, #446) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/447
* core: en låst runtime-struct, TranscribeRequest och färre positionsargument i whisper, del 2 (#371) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/472
* ci(windows): flerkommandosteg i windows-package.yml körs med bash så att fel fäller steget (#436) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/471
* fix(code-health): bound concurrent CI metadata collection by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/476
* cli: diariseringsseam, stegvis diariserad pipeline och injicerat avbrott, del 3 (#343) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/475
* build(deps): bump the cargo group across 2 directories with 20 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/451
* core: interna sökvägar, pub(crate) och lagerregler, del 2b (#372) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/477
* fel: typad SettingsError och typade kommandofel i resten av appen, del 2a (#360) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/474
* core: gemensam modellkatalog, en sha256-hjälpare och delad ordlistevalidering, del 2 (#373) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/479
* core: ordtidsstämplar och DTW utan feature-grind, del 3 (#371) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/480
* core: omkörning av möten, diariseringscache och förslag flyttade från CLI:t, del 1 (#374) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/485
* app: typade fel i events, avbrutet som avbrutet och återställningsknappar, del 2b (#360) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/482
* fix(deps): update distrusted certificate dependencies by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/488
* core: mötespipelinen i core och tester för mötesjobb, del 2 (#374) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/486
* fix(deps): patch bundled Vite editor vulnerabilities by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/489
* code-health: CLI-mätningen av komplexitet fungerar igen efter flyttarna by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/487
* chore(release): prepare 1.4.5 and validate standalone host versions by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/490


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/compare/v1.4.4...v1.4.5

stable144.name: v1.4.4
stable144.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(release): accept full commit SHA in Windows acceptance evidence by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/297
* Pianissimo context biasing with the personal dictionary, phase 1 (Refs #298) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/302
* Refs #284: diarization finds the right number of speakers on Swedish debates by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/301
* Fix flaky idle_unload_then_shutdown test by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/307
* Diarization speaker-count hint (core + CLI), Refs #305 by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/308
* Private, exclusive temp files for atomic settings/glossary saves by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/317
* Bound decoder error retries and decoded-byte growth (fixes #311, #312) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/318
* Bound model-download bytes and duration (#314) by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/316
* Show elapsed time and status during meeting transcription by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/321
* Build native diarization evaluation and evidence workflow by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/330
* Research: qualify cross-language code-health metrics with explicit limits by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/334
* Preserve diarization recovery and tighten evaluation contracts by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/333
* Expose effective diarization decoder settings in CLI progress by @Magnus-Gille in https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/pull/335


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/compare/v1.4.3...v1.4.4
